seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: The ABC7 table (updated July 14, 2026) shows Friedman 53% (102,384) and Meyers 17% (32,216), though the summary said the table header read District 20. The LA Almanac labels Friedman a majority winner. Meyers's primary opponents included Dennis Feitosa (R). Name form: AP uses Scott Meyers, iVoterGuide uses Scott Alan Meyers, and Cook spells it Scott Alan Meyerys (likely a typo). The ballot form is unverified. A search summary said Friedman has represented the district since January 2025, but the source was unclear. Friedman's earlier offices (state Assembly, local office), education, and birth details were not researched because the web-search budget ran out.
